text:
carlos: Quick policy check 1 1 1 Do I need to upload boarding passes for every flight? I always misplace them.

emma_people_ops: Short version: we need proof of travel. Preferred docs: airline e-ticket/itinerary + boarding pass or the airline payment receipt that shows passenger name, flight number, and fare. If you genuinely can't find the boarding pass, attach the e-ticket screenshot and a short note + manager sign-off.

emma_people_ops: Also domestic per-diems: standard US domestic per-diem is $60/day USD for meals & incidentals. For short regional trips under 24 hours (no overnight) we allow up to $25 flat local meals. International per-diem varies by country 1 submit actual receipts or use the per-diem table on the Travel Portal.

liam: If the client buys dinner for the whole table, can I still claim per-diem?

emma_people_ops: No 1 you should not claim per-diem if the meal was provided by the client or included in registration. Instead, mark the meal as "provided" in Expensify and attach the invoice/receipt showing paid by client/vendor. If a shared tab was partially covered, submit actual itemized receipt and note which items were Redwood's.

carlos: What about alcohol? Occasionally client dinners include wine.

emma_people_ops: Alcohol is reimbursable up to reasonable limits. For internal policy: alcohol is allowed within a $30 per-person limit on meal claims and must be itemized on the receipt. Anything beyond requires manager approval and a brief business justification.

liam: Hotels 1 I get a big incidental hold when I check in on my card. Will Redwood reimburse that?

emma_people_ops: Hotel holds (pre-authorizations) are not reimbursed as charges 1 they drop off by the card issuer. If the hotel posts an actual incidental charge to your card, submit the statement line plus the hotel folio. For corporate card holders, incidentals should go on the corporate card when possible to avoid personal holds.

carlos: Conference fees 1 do we book under Redwood or do we register personally and get reimbursed? Some vendors ask for a PO.

emma_people_ops: Conferences with vendor invoicing: Finance can issue a PO and pay directly if you route the request through People Ops with event details and cost code. If you register personally because there's no PO option, save the registration receipt and attach it to Expensify; note if refund is possible. For higher-value events (> $2,500) get People Ops pre-approval.

julia_manager: Approved for Carlos's trip once receipts + boarding pass or manager note are uploaded.

finance_bot: Expensify: report "SFO->SEA conference - Carlos" created by carlos 1 status: awaiting receipts. Processing ETA 5-7 business days after manager approval.

carlos: Sample expense note I'll add:
```
Trip: SFO -> SEA
Dates: 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-04
Flights: booked on personal card, e-ticket attached
Meals: claiming per-diem $60/day
Conference: registration (receipt attached) 
Hotel: folio attached for incidental charges
Manager: Julia
```

liam: Lost receipt scenario?

emma_people_ops: Submit the Lost Receipt Affidavit in Expensify, include your card statement line and a manager attestation. For amounts under $15 we can accept card statement + note from you.

carlos: Cool, thanks all. I'll upload what I have and ping Julia. :thumbsup:
